package.name: g1_action
package.description: Safety-critical realtime execution package for the Unitree G1 EDU Ultimate D (U6) hybrid VLA system: receding-horizon ActionChunk execution with dual-path blending and a five-stage safety pipeline (action_executor_node), aggregate risk estimation (risk_estimator_node) and the Inspire hand bridge, RH56E2 Modbus TCP or RH56DFQ serial (inspire_hand_bridge_node).
